links.outcome: Hidden subgroup performance disparities masked by average model performance
links.effect: Average performance may be high while some subgroups have significantly lower performance; AFISP applied to a deterioration model to detect significant subgroup disparities (no numeric results in abstract).
links.quote: While a model's average performance on a dataset may be high, the model can have significantly lower performance for certain subgroups, which may be hard to detect.

unlisted_practices: Algorithmic data-driven discovery of unlabeled, interpretable patient subgroups with lower model performance
Scalable subgroup disparity detection algorithm compared with existing algorithmic approaches

screen.reason: Empirically demonstrates an algorithmic framework (AFISP) applied to a clinical deterioration model to audit for hidden subgroup performance disparities and failure modes prior to deployment.

primary.practice: subgroup disparity and failure mode auditing prior to deployment
